findings.title: Puncture and Winged Form can win the dash selection
findings.evidence: Base #59 and Update6 #3: entries select Puncture, then Winged Form, then Onslaught, then normal dash. Puncture’s nested selector (#63) contains only its normal and winged clips. State references were checked by GUID and use the active-state accessor.
findings.impact: The README promises the rush in either form, including with Blood Dash equipped. Under the existing ordered-selector convention, those earlier branches bypass it.
findings.action: Validate SPECIAL → DASH in normal form, Winged Form, with Puncture, and with both. If this matches the graph, adjust both selectors and retain Puncture’s blood gain deliberately.
findings.confidence: Static control-flow finding; not reproduced in game.

findings.title: Blood Lash attacks still clear Onslaught readiness
findings.evidence: Base #231 State Ultimate 2 Basic Attack keeps Event Skill Attack Special Rush Reset (#109) in while_active. The reset clears both the flag and timer.
findings.impact: SPECIAL → Blood Lash ATTACK → DASH can lose the armed rush even though the README says ATTACK keeps it ready.
findings.action: Test that sequence with Blood Lash active. Review the inherited reset before claiming that all attacks preserve the charge.
findings.confidence: Direct reference in supplied bytes; gameplay timing untested.

findings.title: Copying the bite also copies its talent effects
findings.evidence: Base #2032 Skill Attack Special Rush Damage owns five copied damage-debuff objects (object IDs 2032–2036). They reference bleed detection, Sadism, Go for the Throat, Injection, and Victimization; its impact/kill callbacks also point to SPECIAL events.
findings.impact: The rush can attempt bite-side effects on enemies it crosses. This is broader than “scale from bite damage” and may make Injection multi-target. Life Essence credit still depends on how its kill flag is consumed.
findings.action: Decide later whether these are desired bridges. First record per-target seed/mark application, distance scaling, and kill-credit behavior. Do not strip them just because they are unexpected.
findings.confidence: Hooks confirmed; resulting procs and damage require runtime verification.

findings.title: The replacement descriptions are English in every language
findings.evidence: Both modified description rows (18 and 40) are identical English text in all 13 supplied language banks, including FR, DE, JA and ZH-S. manifest.toml also provides English replacements.
findings.impact: Players using those languages see English cards. README calls the package “localized card text,” which overstates what is shipped.
findings.action: Describe these as English fallback strings, or supply actual translations and ensure the manifest text step preserves them.
findings.confidence: Confirmed from all supplied text banks.

findings.title: The dash-end Seductive request remains separate
findings.evidence: Update6 #4 routes directionless DASH into a dedicated taunt controller. The six-second cooldown value remains. The package README limits its stated rework to Blood Reserve and Onslaught.
findings.impact: Installing this package does not establish the earlier request to taunt at the end of a completed directional dash.
findings.action: Keep this visible as earlier requested work, not as a regression introduced by 0.4.2.
findings.confidence: Current controller/card path confirmed; no vanilla binary diff available.

feedback.quote: so like for example blood rage (starting talent) doesnt synergize with injection... for some reason.. clear design flaw if you asked me
feedback.verdict: Plausible completion-bonus gap; not zero shared value
feedback.analysis: Blood Rage’s quest rewards general DMG, which can still help other attacks. Its completion condition checks POWER blood use and the hold chronometer. Injection uses the Power Orb spawner with an “explode now” value, so a held-cast reward is not automatically inherited. The final orb formula is missing.
feedback.test: Compare Injection damage before/after quest completion at identical DMG, rarity, level and target; separately test a qualifying held POWER cast. Control for DMG earned during the quest.

feedback.quote: blood reserve is completely artificial, only impalement ultimate TRULY benefits from it.
feedback.verdict: Strong concern about payoff, too absolute as a mechanics claim
feedback.analysis: Impalement directly converts blood spent into damage. Capacity also buys potential channel/winged uptime and reduces overflow, but only when blood generation can fill it. That makes the value less visible and less immediate. The submitted replacement turns reserve into an ATTACK payoff and introduces a new spend-versus-hold tension.
feedback.test: Compare time at full blood, wasted generation, channel duration, and Impalement damage. Separate “has a benefit” from “worth a talent slot.”

feedback.quote: bleed ticks only for 5 seconds I believe, +-, so flesh rip and furious tempest have almost zero synergy.. by the time you stack your tempest, bleed fades out so your flesh rip is offline and you rely on your teammates applying bleed
feedback.verdict: Timing friction supported; exact duration unverified
feedback.analysis: The package’s Tempest ramp duration is 3 seconds. If bleed lasts 5 seconds and POWER begins immediately, a 2-second full-ramp overlap is possible before animation and travel costs. That is fragile rather than inherently zero. Bleed duration, refresh rules and channel-end sampling need the missing status/orb data or a controlled run.
feedback.test: Apply your own bleed, start POWER after a measured delay, and release before/after expiry. Repeat using Dispersion and teammate bleed. Log crit rate and damage separately.

feedback.quote: gust + life tap + angel & demon (will be fixed in next patch)
feedback.verdict: Version-sensitive report; not a confirmed future patch
feedback.analysis: Official 1.06 notes (12 October 2026) already announce Life Tap triggering every TRAIT talent. The supplied Update6 layer calls Angel and Demon’s tester and selects a Gust-specific Life Tap clip. That supports intended connectivity, but a combined-path bug could still exist. No newer promised fix was established.
feedback.test: Record game version/platform. Compare Life Tap alone, with Gust, with Angel and Demon, and with both, in day and night; check health cost, blood gain, healing/STRENGTH and knockback.
